glosses: sugary (exaggeratedly sweet and pleasant, often to the point of aversion)

examples.text: At the church sociables he used to hop around among them, chipping and chirping like a dicky-bird picking up seed; and he was a great hand to play the piano, and sing saddish, sweetish songs to them.
Up half the night, nearly 'til dawn, I can almost see the light in a love that can't go wrong, It's just another sweetish love song.
Pine Nuts are sweetish in flavor, warming, and lack poison.
